# Power & oil
[textlink="Mining & Industry" link="CMUGuideIndustry"] · [textlink="Equipment recipes" link="CMUGuideIndustryRecipes"]
[bold]Generator → HV cable → step-down transformer → MV cable → electrical panel → nearby machines.[/bold] Anchor the electrical panel directly over the MV cable; it supplies powered devices within five tiles. Anchor equipment and connect the matching cable networks. A generator alone does not power every machine in the room.
## Choose a source - [bold]Steam:[/bold] feed steam from your boiler to the generator. - [bold]Solar:[/bold] expose panels to sunlight and orient them toward it; shade reduces output. - [bold]Diesel / gas turbine:[/bold] supply the specified fuel through a suitable container or fluid connection. Keep the tank filled. - [bold]Geothermal:[/bold] place near lava; ordinary cave floor supplies no heat. - [bold]Battery buffer / bank:[/bold] store surplus generation. They need charging before they can cover shortages.
Cable shafts connect matching voltage networks between Z-levels. Keep HV, MV and LV separate. Use a powered cell charger for removable tool cells.

## Turn oil into useful supplies
1. Activate a [textlink="prospector" link="CMUGuideIndustryTools"] to find nearby deposits. Place the oil pump on one and power it. 2. Lay a touching [textlink="liquid pipe run" link="CMUGuideIndustryPipes"] from the pump to the tower. Use a screwdriver on the first pipe, then the pump → OUTPUT → Connect selected pipe. Select the last pipe, then the tower → crude oil INPUT → Connect selected pipe. 3. Connect storage/output routes for [bold]all fractions[/bold]: naphtha, light fuel, heavy fuel and refinery gas. Full outputs can stop production. 4. Route light fuel and heavy fuel to the fuel mixer's matching INPUTS. [bold]30 units light fuel + 20 units heavy fuel → 50 units diesel.[/bold] Connect its diesel OUTPUT to a separate barrel's INPUT. Supply power and leave room for the finished fuel.
[bold]Sell diesel:[/bold] move the filled barrel onto the colony ASRS elevator and send it away using the requisitions console. Diesel pays per unit actually inside; an empty barrel does not earn the fuel's value. [textlink="Selling controls" link="CMUGuideIndustryProducts"]
For plastics: crack suitable fractions into ethylene, polymerize it into pellets, then use a bender for sheets.
Open each machine's window for its exact inputs, fluids and circuit. To fill a canister, hold it and right-click a fillable tank → [bold]Draw the liquid into the container[/bold]. Click a fillable tank or generator with the filled canister to pour it in.
